title: unified-orbit-rollout-runtime-with-early-safety-cutpoints
author: Maya Singh
description:
Context: We need a single runtime path that unifies canary, A/B, and shadow traffic workflows so operators can declare multi-mode rollouts in one policy without wiring custom controllers. This PR implements the "Orbit" rollout runtime: a declarative execution graph, early safety cutpoints, and a lightweight playbook-based rollback adapter.

Motivation: Current rollout logic is scattered across multiple controllers and ad-hoc scripts. Teams running hybrid experiments (shadow + canary) must coordinate manually. Orbit aims to reduce operator cognitive load, enable reproducible safeguards, and surface actionable telemetry for automated rollback decisions.

What this PR does (summary):
- Adds a declarative rollout graph schema (api/rollout_graph.proto) that supports nodes for shadow, canary, multi-arm A/B splits, and stop/fallback hooks.
- Implements a runtime executor (pkg/rollout/orbit) that evaluates node predicates, applies traffic transforms (split/mirror), and enforces early safety cutpoints (latency, error-rate, fidelity diff).
- Introduces a rollback playbook adapter (pkg/rollout/playbook) that composes audit-safe rollback steps (drain, snapshot-promote, quota-unbind) to run automatically when gates fail.
- Adds a compact simulator (cmd/rollout-sim) for local testing of rollout policies against synthetic traces.
- Exposes new telemetry: rollout_epoch, gate_evaluation:pass|fail, fidelity_delta; surfaced into Console and trace spans.

Migration notes: Existing rollout policies remain supported. A one-line conversion script (tools/rollout-migrate) translates older YAML to the new graph schema. Customers on Dedicated with custom controllers will see no behavioral change until they opt in.

Testing and validation: Included unit tests for the executor logic, integration tests that run simulated clusters in CI, and a canary runbook used to validate on staging (see docs/playbooks/orbit-canary.md).

Checklist: 
- [x] api design review (ENG-2742)
- [x] telemetry integration (SLO team)
- [x] docs/console updates (docs/playbooks)
- [x] rollout simulator smoke tests
- [x] safety playbook unit tests

Related work: Linear ENG-2742, design note: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2742/unified-orbit-rollout-proposal.

Notes: This PR tries to minimize runtime heap pressure by using a streaming evaluator for predicates and avoids keeping entire traffic snapshots in memory. The earliest gate evaluation happens after warmup buckets (configurable; default 500 requests) to avoid noisy early aborts.
